mapper.insert:
MERGE INTO OFT_RECIPE target USING ( SELECT #{externalRecipeId} AS EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID, #{recipeName} AS RECIPE_NAME, #{description} AS DESCRIPTION, #{cookTime} AS COOK_TIME, #{difficulty} AS DIFFICULTY, #{calories} AS CALORIES, #{imageUrl} AS IMAGE_URL, #{sourceName} AS SOURCE_NAME FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID = source.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.RECIPE_NAME = source.RECIPE_NAME, target.DESCRIPTION = source.DESCRIPTION, target.COOK_TIME = source.COOK_TIME, target.DIFFICULTY = source.DIFFICULTY, target.CALORIES = source.CALORIES, target.IMAGE_URL = source.IMAGE_URL, target.SOURCE_NAME = source.SOURCE_NAME WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COOK_TIME, DIFFICULTY, CALORIES, IMAGE_URL, SOURCE_NAME ) VALUES ( source.EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID, source.RECIPE_NAME, source.DESCRIPTION, source.COOK_TIME, source.DIFFICULTY, source.CALORIES, source.IMAGE_URL, source.SOURCE_NAME )
SELECT RECIPE_NO FROM OFT_RECIPE WHERE EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID = #{externalRecipeId}
mapper.select: SELECT RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, EXTERNAL_RECIPE_ID AS externalRecipeId, RECIPE_NAME AS recipeName, DESCRIPTION AS description, COOK_TIME AS cookTime, DIFFICULTY AS difficulty, CALORIES AS calories, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, SOURCE_NAME AS sourceName FROM OFT_RECIPE WHERE RECIPE_NO = #{value}
SELECT INGREDIENT_NO AS ingredientNo, RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, INGREDIENT_NAME AS ingredientName, AMOUNT AS amount FROM OFT_RECIPE_INGREDIENT WHERE RECIPE_NO = #{value} ORDER BY INGREDIENT_NO ASC
SELECT STEP_NO AS stepNo, RECIPE_NO AS recipeNo, STEP_SEQ AS stepSeq, DESCRIPTION AS description FROM OFT_RECIPE_STEP WHERE RECIPE_NO = #{value} ORDER BY STEP_SEQ ASC

SELECT imageTable.STEP_IMAGE_NO AS stepImageNo, imageTable.STEP_NO AS stepNo, imageTable.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, imageTable.SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM OFT_RECIPE_STEP_IMAGE imageTable INNER JOIN OFT_RECIPE_STEP stepTable ON stepTable.STEP_NO = imageTable.STEP_NO WHERE stepTable.RECIPE_NO = #{value} ORDER BY stepTable.STEP_SEQ ASC, imageTable.SORT_ORDER ASC
